title: Amorphous cobalt–copper oxide for upgrading anodic electro-oxidation of glycerol to formate in a basic medium
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, 9,1565-1575
DOI: 10.1039/D4SE01317D, Paper
Biplab Kumar Manna, Rajib Samanta, Manjunatha Kempasiddaiah, Sudip Barman
An amorphous Co3O4–CuO/CNx-300 composite on a carbon cloth reveals high activity for electrochemical glycerol oxidation, efficiently producing formic acid and reducing water splitting energy consumption by 15.48%.
